For the S7 cases (read 2026-11-08): dirc.xml, drich.xml and tof_barrel.xml in full, optical_materials.xml at the QuartzOptical and Aerogel_DRICH definitions and the aerogel RINDEX table, definitions_craterlake.xml at the TOF block, definitions.xml at the PID region constants, DRICH_geo.cpp at the vessel and sector construction.
